summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with the public load_decathalon_datalist function and underscore-prefixed helpers, imported only os and json. Exported it explicitly from monai/data/__init__.py. Added a "Decathalon DataLoader" subsection with an autofunction entry to docs/source/data.rst after the Utilities block. Added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist covering test_seg_values, test_cls_values, test_seg_no_basedir and test_seg_no_labels. Tests, black, and flake8 were not run, per the instructions. A line-length scan found no lines over 120 columns. Nothing was committed. Choices: string annotations ("str | None", "list[dict]") to avoid importing typing on Python 3.9; a non-list value under the data key raises ValueError; a non-object top level is treated as a missing key; malformed JSON propagates as json.JSONDecodeError, a ValueError subclass.
